info.title: Printify Public API
info.description:
## Getting started

Printify API enables you to automate product and order creation for a variety of scenarios,
including integration with your on-site design generator, on-site product customization and more.

tags.name: Shops
tags.description: Manage Printify shops and shop connections. Retrieve shop information and disconnect shops from your account.

tags.name: Catalog
tags.description: Browse the Printify catalog including blueprints, print providers, product variants, and shipping information. Explore available products and their customization options.

tags.name: Products
tags.description: Create, update, delete, and manage products in your shop. Publish products to sales channels and handle product lifecycle events including GPSR compliance information.

tags.name: Orders
tags.description: Create and manage orders including standard orders, Printify Express orders, and order lifecycle management. Calculate shipping costs and track order fulfillment.

tags.name: Personalization
tags.description: Configure custom per-buyer personalization options for a product variant, generate mockup previews, and attach a personalization to an order line item.

tags.name: Support Requests
tags.description: Retrieve order-scoped support requests (refunds, reprints, address changes, and other order support cases) and their current status and outcome.

tags.name: Uploads
tags.description: Upload and manage images and assets. Upload images from URLs or base64-encoded content, retrieve upload information, and archive uploaded images.

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description: Configure webhooks to receive notifications about order and product events. Create, update, and delete webhook subscriptions.

tags.name: V2 Catalog Blueprints
tags.description: V2 API endpoints for catalog and shipping information. Retrieve shipping methods and variant-specific shipping details using JSON API format.

post.description: Submit an order
Cancel an order

Cancel a single line item on a pre-production order. If this is the last active line item, the whole order is cancelled too.

This endpoint is not idempotent: calling it again for an already-cancelled line item returns a 400, not a repeated 204.

Eligibility is checked against the order's own pre-production flow (`PENDING`, `ON_HOLD`, `PAYMENT_NOT_RECEIVED`, `HAS_ISSUES`, `SOURCE_CHECK_FAILED`), which is intentionally broader than the statuses accepted by `POST /orders/{order_id}/cancel.json`. An order in `PENDING`, `HAS_ISSUES`, or `SOURCE_CHECK_FAILED` can have a line item cancelled here even though the whole-order cancel endpoint would reject it.

productionTime.description: Average production time of the blueprint at this print provider, based on recent orders. `null` when no production time is recorded for the print provider yet. Print providers with only a few recent orders report a default estimate of 2.9 business days.

average.description: Average production time, rounded to one decimal.

countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes this profile applies to. `REST_OF_THE_WORLD` means every country not listed in another profile.

types.description: Measurement types (e.g. width, length), each with one range per size.

pattern.description: Requests must send all four values as numbers. In responses a value can be null when the product was last edited outside the Public API and the stored pattern lacks it.

src.description: Filled in from the uploaded image. In list, create and update responses it can be an empty string or missing; the single product endpoint always returns it.

angle.description: Rotation in degrees. Requests must send an integer. Responses can contain a fractional angle when the product was last edited outside the Public API.

print_on_side.description: Side printing for canvases: `regular` extends the print area to the sides, `mirror` mirrors it to the sides, `off` stops printing on the sides.

external.description: References to the product in the sales channel, set with the publishing succeeded endpoint. Omitted when the product has not been published.

is_economy_shipping_eligible.description: Whether the product can be eligible for Economy shipping, depending on the selection of its variants. Read-only.

is_economy_shipping_enabled.description: Whether Economy shipping is enabled for the product. Set it when creating or updating the product. An order can use Economy shipping (`shipping_method` 4) only if every product in it has this flag enabled.

print_details.description: Print details of the product. An empty array `[]` when the product has none.

sales_channel_properties.description: Sales channel specific properties of the product. An empty array `[]` when the product has none.

salesChannelPropertiesInput.description: Properties specific to the sales channel of the shop. Which keys apply depends on the sales channel: Amazon - `free_shipping`, `bullet_points`, `no_variation_parent`, `brand_name`; Etsy - `free_shipping`, `personalisation`; BigCommerce - `categories`, `free_shipping`; eBay - `free_shipping`; Shopify - `collections`, `free_shipping`; Squarespace - `store_page`; TikTok - `delivery_service_id`, `warehouse_id`, `free_shipping`, `personalisation`. Custom integrations have no sales channel properties, so the object is ignored for them. A key that isn't a known sales channel property returns `400`. On update, the object replaces the stored properties: keys that are left out go back to their defaults.

free_shipping.description: Amazon, Etsy, BigCommerce, eBay, Shopify and TikTok.

brand_name.description: Amazon only. An Amazon approved brand name set on the Printify store.

instructions.example: Please provide the name you would like to be printed on the mug

sku.description: An empty string counts as not provided, and the generated SKU is kept.

is_economy_shipping_enabled.description: Enables or disables Economy shipping for the product. An order can use Economy shipping (`shipping_method` 4) only if every product in it has this flag enabled. When omitted, the current value is kept. Setting it to `true` for a product where `is_economy_shipping_eligible` is `false` returns a validation error.

shipping_template_id.description: Shipping template ID in the sales channel

sku.description: An empty string counts as not provided, and the generated SKU is kept.

is_economy_shipping_enabled.description: Enables Economy shipping for the product. An order can use Economy shipping (`shipping_method` 4) only if every product in it has this flag enabled. Applies only to products where `is_economy_shipping_eligible` is `true`; for other products the value is ignored. Defaults to `false`.

shipping_template_id.description: Shipping template ID in the sales channel

reprinted_line_item_id.description: ID of the line item in the reprinted order (see the order's `metadata.reprinted_order_ids`) that this line item reprints. Present only on line items of reprint orders.

status_details.description: Reason for the line item's current status, when it is known and exposed. Omitted otherwise. out_of_stock and discontinued are returned only when the line item is on-hold or canceled; item_is_canceled_by_ip_detection, item_is_canceled_due_missing_external_shipping_label and canceled_by_print_provider only when it is canceled.

sent_to_production_at.description: Date and time in UTC, in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS+00:00` format. Omitted until set.

fulfilled_at.description: Date and time in UTC, in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS+00:00` format. Omitted until set.

estimated_ship_at.description: Estimated date the line item ships, in UTC. Returned when retrieving a single order and in Printify Express order responses, and omitted when there is no estimate.

estimated_delivery_at.description: Estimated date the line item is delivered, in UTC. Returned when retrieving a single order and in Printify Express order responses, and omitted when there is no estimate.

shop_fulfilled_at.description: Date and time in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS±HH:MM` format. Omitted when the order has not been fulfilled in the sales channel.

is_reprint.description: Whether this order is a reprint or replacement order. Always present; `false` when the order is not a reprint/replacement.

costs_covered.description: Whether the production and shipping costs of this order are covered, for example a reprint or replacement issued at no charge to the store. Cost fields still show the order's calculated cost. Always present; `false` when the costs are not covered.

reprinted_order_ids.description: IDs of the original orders this order reprints or replaces. Always present; an empty array when the order is not a reprint/replacement.

child_reprinted_order_ids.description: IDs of orders that reprint or replace this order. Always present; an empty array when this order has no reprints/replacements.

delivered_at.description: Date and time in UTC, in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS+00:00` format. Null until set.

line_item_ids.description: Ids of the order line items (line_items[].id) included in the shipment.

shipments.description: Omitted when the order has no shipments yet.

fulfilled_at.description: Date and time in UTC, in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS+00:00` format. Omitted until set.

personalisation.description: Attaches a personalization created via the Create a personalization configuration endpoint to an order line item.

personalisation_strategy.description: Pass this value exactly as returned by the Create a personalization configuration response — it is an opaque value and should not be constructed manually. The one value worth knowing about explicitly is `manual`, which indicates a mapping issue caused by a label inconsistency (the personalizable product was changed). The order will require manual adjustment from the merchant and won't be sent to production automatically.

personalisation_instructions.description: Pass this value exactly as returned by the Create a personalization configuration response. It is an opaque reference token for most strategies, or human-readable free text when personalisation_strategy is manual.

shipping_method.description: Shipping method of the order: 1 standard, 2 priority, 3 Printify Express, 4 Economy. Defaults to 1. Economy (4) is available only when every product in the order is eligible for it and has `is_economy_shipping_enabled` set to `true`, and the order ships to the US (excluding US islands). Otherwise the request fails with 422.

image_url.description: Required when the item type is "image".

items.description: At most 12 items can have the type "image".

approval.description:
Optional buyer approval of this personalization.

- Send it only after the buyer approves this personalization.
- It applies to every order that uses this config.
- It is ignored if any buyer input could not be applied, and the merchant reviews the order.
- Automatic submission needs the merchant setting "Automatically submit personalized orders that were approved by the buyer".
- The order then follows the merchant's submission rule.

require_all_personalization_fields.description:
Optional. When `true`, the request must include an item for every field returned by the personalization options endpoint.

- If any field is missing, the request fails with `400` and lists the missing `field_id` values.
- Use it to make sure no personalization field falls back to the product's placeholder design.
- Defaults to `false`.

personalisation_strategy.description: An opaque value. Pass it exactly as returned to the `personalisation` object of the order line item. `manual` means the personalization couldn't be resolved automatically, and the order will need a manual adjustment from the merchant.

personalisation_instructions.description: Pass it exactly as returned, together with `personalisation_strategy`. An opaque reference for most strategies, or human-readable free text when `personalisation_strategy` is `manual`.

personalization.description: At most 12 items can have the type "image".

format.description: Optional preview image format. "png" renders the previews with a transparent background. Omit it to keep the default format and the mockup's default background.

priority.description: Queues the task in a separate priority lane so it is processed independently of the shop's regular previews. Honoured only for accounts with an agreed priority allowance; ignored for everyone else.

personalized.description: Whether src is a personalized buyer-preview render. False when the product's mockup had nothing to personalize and src falls back to the product's plain, unpersonalized mockup image instead.

task_id.description: Opaque task identifier. A request for the same product with the same external_id, variant_ids, personalization and format returns the existing task with the same task_id.

error.description: Present only when status is "failed" or "corrupt".

secret.description: Optional new secret used to sign webhook payloads. Omit it or send null to keep the current secret, or send an empty string to remove it. It is never returned in responses.

code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, or `REST_OF_THE_WORLD` for every country not listed separately.

handlingTimeRange.description: Handling time range in business days. null when there is no delivery time estimate for the destination, which can happen for express and economy shipping outside the US.

show-out-of-stock.description:
Depending on the value, it shows all variants or only those not out of stock. Without passing this query param, the list will contain only those variants in stock.
0 - show only variants that are in stock.
1 - also show variants out of stock (all variants).
Only `0` and `1` are accepted; `true` and `false` are not.
